s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic eye symptoms with progressive vision loss and conjunctival abnormalities
key_facts: 43-year-old man
Initial visual acuity 20/20 OD and 20/30 OS
Vision deteriorated to 20/30 OD and counting fingers OS
Slit lamp examination revealed subconjunctival fibrosis
Slit lamp examination revealed symblepharon formation
Slit lamp examination revealed corneal neovascularizations
Slit lamp examination revealed conjunctival hyperemia
Conjunctival biopsy and immunofluorescent histology revealed an unspecific result

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic eye symptoms with progressive vision loss and conjunctival abnormalities
key_facts: 43-year-old man
Initial visual acuity 20/20 OD and 20/30 OS
Vision deteriorated to 20/30 OD and counting fingers OS
Slit lamp examination revealed subconjunctival fibrosis
Slit lamp examination revealed symblepharon formation
Slit lamp examination revealed corneal neovascularizations
Slit lamp examination revealed conjunctival hyperemia
Conjunctival biopsy and immunofluorescent histology revealed an unspecific result

raw.rationale: The presence of subconjunctival fibrosis, symblepharon formation, corneal neovascularizations, and conjunctival hyperemia are consistent with chronic conjunctivitis, which can lead to vision deterioration as seen in the patient.

rejected.label: keratitis
rejected.why: While keratitis can cause vision problems and corneal neovascularizations, the presence of subconjunctival fibrosis and symblepharon formation are more indicative of conjunctivitis.

rejected.label: bacterial conjunctivitis
rejected.why: The unspecific result from the conjunctival biopsy and immunofluorescent histology does not support a specific bacterial cause.

rejected.label: corneal edema
rejected.why: Corneal edema is not directly indicated by the symptoms, and the presence of subconjunctival fibrosis and symblepharon formation point more towards conjunctivitis.

rejected.label: uveitis
rejected.why: Uveitis typically involves inflammation of the uvea, which is not directly indicated by the symptoms and findings, such as subconjunctival fibrosis and symblepharon formation.
